notes.title: v1.0.0
notes.content:
Finally! Version 1.0 is released!

Apart from 9 new levels, we made quite a few additions to the game.

[h2]Superfast car[/h2]

A new superfast car can be found somewhere in Los Ricos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/b99b417a694778dafbed53fd7a753a404a3a4f60.png[/img]

[h2]New trap[/h2]

Hacking device is a new trap that you can use to temporarily disable police cars chasing you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/8d897da6c3b71841e3611e3d047a854bab57deb6.png[/img]

[h2]New buildings[/h2]

Shops, hotels and factories are only a few examples of new buildings that you will notice in the game (if you slow down a bit).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/73f5abd19696c7a2f46562034ce0045ebbb6e12e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/53e7f9fbb64b539bb85d9abc2b740a956ee413ab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/daf38da632d02369f7833156ef9b489157875f1a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/087bf56077baa0a7abd8aed75d2ac0b0376c71c3.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]

Steam Achievements are now available to collect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/3c97161240c268ec89fa9efb858ef2ce46021e67.png[/img]



[h2]Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] 9 new levels in desert region
[*] Steam achievements
[*] New supercar to drive
[*] New pursuit police supercar
[*] More car colours
[*] New trap: hacking device
[*] New buildings
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Drawing of concave districts on minimap
[/list]

notes.title: v0.4.0
notes.content:
In this month's update, we're bringing you another 3 desert levels. There are also new car colours, as well as a new sport car.

[h2]Car Colour Selection[/h2]
All available cars now in different colours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/85f4b18050d4a83afea8990c5a26688c124ad566.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/490a8e20dde685fe266125275c4e2d6ebc93e9f6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/22ba3635c726c5e03d6aa3f235582600f8e27997.png[/img]

[h2]Sport Car[/h2]
A new sport car is available for you (and for the police).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/f4e3d5fd5e2cf9b2b13d39ada0d7c0b3390b23c6.png[/img]

[h2]Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add 3 new levels in desert region
[*] Add car colour selection in the garage
[*] New sport car to drive
[*] New pursuit police car
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Police car textures depend on location
[*] Increase maximum number of lights used for rendering
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor police AI improvements
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.0
notes.content:
In this month's update, we wanted to finally challenge you with some more neighbourhoods to play in. That's why we're bringing you 3 new desert levels.

[h2]Travelling Between Regions[/h2]
It is now possible to travel to other regions. Just drive to a travelling location and use primary action. Don't worry, you can always go back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/d09313e7c4ccc0f069cdb8b82395ea4a0ee4ddf6.png[/img]

[h2]Desert Biome[/h2]
El Gran Desierto is a brand new region located in the desert. Enjoy the warm sand, cacti and palms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/ab7d76920e0183f71761e55ed725b79b68c3bd3f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/cd942a210bd4fb564fc216a124afb8a17e0b4e52.png[/img]

[h2]Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] New region with a desert biome
[*] New types of vegetation: saguaro cacti, date palms, tall grass
[*] 3 brand new levels
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improve ground textures and rendering algorithm
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix police car behaviour when it reaches a dead end
[/list]

notes.title: v0.2.0
notes.content:
In this month's update, we've focused mainly on improvements of shaders and game engine optimisation. However, there are a few other changes that you will notice in the game.

[h2]Garage Makeover[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/bf03050f8c122f49303ba83f10bce4901f32a2cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/a803386785ae787817e2d1fdd9cf737fad647bef.png[/img]

[h2]New Objects In The World[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/08d3e351a62d1c6ca9e131ff3054e06de3d18525.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/77b7c9b912a0a14e5c267b08acda35f03b4eef11.png[/img]

[h2]Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pause game level (neighbourhood) when the window loses focus
[*] Pause game level (neighbourhood) when Steam overlay is shown
[*] Traffic lights at selected junctions
[*] Petrol station building
[*] Display the garage
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replace low-poly trees with more sophisticated models
[*] Improve bends on the world map
[*] Improve algorithm for environmental lighting
[*] Improve some materials
[*] Exclude version from names of game packages to optimise update downloads
[*] Group models and textures in several packages to minimise download size
[*] Change game icon to more readable at small size
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Restore keyboard, mouse and/or game controller input after Steam overlay is hidden
[*] Fix algorithm for selecting lights used in rendering of given object
[/list]

notes.title: v0.1.1
notes.content:
A small update to let you feel holiday spirit in the game.

We have replaced some of the trees in the game with conifers. During festive period, you should notice Christmas tree lights in several places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43274252/64f0885441ff759e520a2932cae8eb567995cf6d.gif[/img]

Happy holidays!

[h2]Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Conifers (some existing trees replaced by conifers)
[*] Christmas lights on some conifers (visible only 24 Dec - 1 Jan)
[/list]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Visibility of lights from objects (neon lights, Christmas lights, etc.) inside a level
[*] Delayed navigation to a different screen
[/list]
